method: Four fresh independent graders, disjoint fixed question blocks. Every original raw-entry field retained in grader inputs. Same-entry operative quotations count; asked contradictions and unresolved clauses fail. No source/key/scope changes.

reader_evidence.answer: Each player uses the chosen hero’s matching components; shuffle that hero’s 30 action cards into a separate face-down deck and draw 5. Set dials to the listed starting health (undialed sidekicks have 1). Younger player places hero on space 1, then sidekicks in separate spaces sharing a zone with that hero; for a multizone hero space, use any of its zones. Older player then places hero on space 2 and sidekicks the same way. Alice’s controller chooses BIG or SMALL when placing her. Younger player takes the first turn.

operative_quotations.text:
1. Choose a battlefield and place it on the table. Each player chooses a hero and takes that hero’s components.
2. Set the hero’s and sidekick’s dials to the starting health above; undialed sidekicks have 1 health each.
3. Each player shuffles their **30 action cards into one separate face-down deck**, then draws **5 cards**.
4. The **younger player** places their hero on starting space **1**, then their sidekick(s) in **separate spaces sharing a zone with that hero**. If the hero’s space belongs to several zones, use any of those zones. Make beginning-of-game decisions when placing that player’s fighters. **Alice’s controller**, whether younger or older, chooses **BIG or SMALL when placing Alice** and displays her size token.
5. The **older player** places their hero on starting space **2**, then places sidekicks under the same rules.
6. The younger player takes the first turn.

### Fighter reference

The move value applies to **each** of that player’s fighters during maneuver. Harpies have no health dials; each has 1 health. Other fighters have individual dials. Health cannot increase above the highest number on that fighter’s dial.

| Hero | Starting health | Attack | Move | Sidekick(s): starting health, attack |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| Alice | 13 | Melee | 2 | Jabberwock: 8, melee |
| King Arthur | 18 | Melee | 2 | Merlin: 7, ranged |
| Medusa | 16 | Ranged | 3 | 3 Harpies: 1 each, melee |
| Sinbad | 15 | Melee | 2 | Porter: 6, melee |

reader_evidence.answer: The draws cannot be declined and the discard pile is not reshuffled. With an empty deck, each missing draw deals 2 damage to every fighter; across two missing draws, each surviving fighter takes 4 damage total, as two separate 2-damage events.

operative_quotations.text: - Drawing cards, whether from maneuver or an effect, is **mandatory unless explicitly optional**.

- With an empty deck, your fighters are **exhausted**. Each time you must draw a card you cannot draw, **each of your fighters immediately takes 2 damage instead**. Do **not reshuffle** your discard pile. A mandatory draw of 2 with an empty deck therefore causes two separate 2-damage events to every surviving fighter, unless hero defeat has already ended the game. If only one card remains, draw it and take the exhaustion damage for the next missing draw.

reader_evidence.answer: Sinbad starts at 15 health, melee, and Porter at 6 health, melee; normal move is 2. With 3 Voyages in the discard pile, each may move up to 5 in a maneuver (2+3). A newly played base-2 Voyage has value 5 before other modifiers (2+1 for each of the 3 other Voyages); it is not yet in the discard pile and does not count itself.

operative_quotations.text: | Sinbad | 15 | Melee | 2 | Porter: 6, melee |

**Sinbad:** when you maneuver, each of your fighters may move **+1 space for each VOYAGE card in your discard pile**, added to the normal move value 2 and any maneuver BOOST. The bonus also applies to Porter. Count the Voyages actually in the discard pile when moving: if Voyage Home is discarded to BOOST this maneuver, it already counts there, in addition to its printed BOOST 1. A Voyage’s own combat value is its **printed 2 plus 1 per other Voyage in the discard pile during combat**, before any other modifiers. Resolve this bonus during combat before calculating damage. The card currently being played is not yet in that pile; played cards enter it only at the end of combat. Voyage Home can remove the accumulated cards from the pile, reducing later bonuses.

- Drawing cards, whether from maneuver or an effect, is **mandatory unless explicitly optional**.

Do **not reshuffle** your discard pile. A mandatory draw of 2 with an empty deck therefore causes two separate 2-damage events to every surviving fighter, unless hero defeat has already ended the game. If only one card remains, draw it and take the exhaustion damage for the next missing draw.
- Played and resolved cards and discarded cards go into your own **face-up discard pile**, distinct from the face-down deck. Both players may inspect either discard pile **at any time**.
- Recovery cannot raise a fighter above their dial maximum. A later recovery effect cannot undo the immediate game end from hero defeat.
- “Move” follows paths and blockers; “place” puts the fighter directly in the permitted destination, with **one fighter per space** still required. Card permission to place anywhere is not limited to maneuver distance or a movement path.
